summary: You pick one of the five depth areas and take 12 letter-graded units from its list, at least 6 at the 300 level (BIOE 300B counts as 200-level), plus 9 letter-graded breadth units from the other areas' lists, not counting any course on your own area's list. You also need 15 units of technical courses, which you move in by hand because which courses count is your advisor's call, and 9 more units at the 100 level or above, for 45 units in all; courses below the 100 level, Athletics and EFSLANG do not count toward the 45. Your advisor checks the technical courses' letter grades, 200-level lecture units and independent study cap, and that all units were taken at Stanford. The optional distinction in research adds 3 letter-graded units of EE 300 or EE 391, half-time research over three quarters, a 3.0 GPA and a research report.
